title: Student Identifiers Bill 2013
portfolio: Industry, Innovation, Science, Research and Tertiary Education

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would establish identifiers for students undertaking nationally recognised vocational education and training, linking their enrolments and achievements to authenticated training transcripts.
A new Student Identifiers Agency would administer the scheme, which is proposed for training from 1 January 2014, with rules controlling information handling.

Training organisations generally could not issue qualifications or statements of attainment without an identifier, although the Minister could exempt specified providers, qualifications or individuals.
changes: Personal information collected solely to obtain an identifier would have to be destroyed, unless retention is legally required or it was also collected for another purpose.
Collection, use and disclosure of identifiers would require individual authorisation or a permitted statutory or regulatory basis.
Holders of identifier records would have to protect them against misuse and unauthorised access.
Breaches of specified safeguards could be investigated by the Australian Information Commissioner as privacy interferences.
summary.affected: Vocational education and training students and registered training organisations are affected.
